issue_request: FHIR-36120 was a Published/Persuasive R5 Imaging Integration change request to replace ImagingStudy Coding elements with richer datatypes: ImagingStudy.modality, ImagingStudy.series.modality, and ImagingStudy.series.laterality as CodeableConcept, and ImagingStudy.series.bodySite as CodeableReference targeting BodyStructure.
initial_application: Commit 1891df8e49d773c1958178726f7399e5f5bd7e7e applied the seed with related imaging changes by updating the authoritative ImagingStudy StructureDefinition datatypes, adding the BodyStructure target for series.bodySite, adjusting examples, and moving the body-site token search expression to ImagingStudy.series.bodySite.concept.
additional_context: FHIR-46301 later clarified the then-existing ImagingStudy.series.laterality guidance. FHIR-50859 then made the current R6 decision to keep series.bodySite as CodeableReference, remove ImagingStudy.series.laterality, and add Body Site and Laterality guidance. Existing combined-branch audit commits already represent FHIR-50859 and FHIR-36164. Stale laterality mentions found during this check are limited to the generated-looking ImagingStudy SVG diagram.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current-build ImagingStudy source defines ImagingStudy.modality and ImagingStudy.series.modality as CodeableConcept and ImagingStudy.series.bodySite as CodeableReference with targetProfile BodyStructure; ImagingStudy.series.laterality is absent because of the later FHIR-50859 decision, with narrative guidance covering laterality via series.bodySite codes or BodyStructure references.
